title: Add RAG templates and agent tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds new RAG templates and agent tool-calling quickstarts; updates docs site navigation and quickstart examples. No breaking changes.
description:
Motivation: provide developer-friendly, copy-pasteable RAG templates and agent/tool-calling quickstarts to accelerate adoption and reduce support asks. This PR adds a set of opinionated RAG templates (single-turn, multi-turn, and streaming variants), two agent tool-calling example playbooks (Python + TypeScript), and updates the docs site to surface the new quickstarts in the Getting Started and Examples nav.

What changed: added a new docs section docs/rag/templates with 6 template examples, added redwood-examples/agents/tool-calling with runnable samples and README, and updated website navigation and example landing pages. Also updated some small helper utilities used by the examples (example runners, CI docs-build config).

Checklist: (x) Add templates and quickstarts, (x) Add runnable examples and README, (x) Docs site nav+landing update, (x) docs build passes locally and in CI, (x) Confirmed examples run with mock backend.

Testing: docs-build, unit tests, and example runners passed in CI. Manual smoke tests executed: verified quickstart flow in browser, executed Python and TS examples against local dev server, verified streaming example shows incremental outputs and cancellation.

Notes/Context: These templates reflect patterns discussed in ENG-2421 and the recent RAG playbook doc work; they intentionally include minimal orchestration so teams can adopt patterns quickly. The examples include comments on latency/cost tradeoffs and recommended model variants for hosted vs dedicated deployments.

Commits summary and high-level diffs are below; see changed_files field for a top-level list. CI: docs-build, unit-tests, lint, and examples-runner were green on the final run. Merge method: squash.

Additional links: Linear ENG-2421 (RAG quickstarts), related PRs: pr-50877 (prior rag templates iteration), pr-50567 (examples cleanup).
